alex: Handoff in 30m — leaving notes/checklist below. PM me if anything odd.

alex: Checklist:
- runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall
- VPN: confirm you can reach 10.20.30.0/24
- Pager: have PagerDuty signed in, test page on staging
- Creds: up-to-date KMS access + secrets-manager role
- Tools: can access prometheus/grafana dashboards

maria: Quick q — is the staging page method `pd trigger test` or via UI? I only have web access.

alex: Either works. Easiest: `curl -X POST https://pd.example/test -H 'Authorization: Token ...'` — I put token in 1password under 'oncall/staging/token'.

sam: I can't reach the VPN right now, hitting auth loop. `openconnect` returns: 'TLS handshake failed'. Anyone else?

jamal: @sam DM me, I had same yesterday; need to update client to 1.1.4. Also check certs: `sudo update-ca-certificates`.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation for team 'infra' starts at 17:00 UTC. See https://redwood.status/schedule

maria: Confirmed VPN + prometheus access. I can view last 24h error rate. :thumbsup:

sam: Reconnected after client update. Pager test succeeded: `pd whoami` shows me as oncall.

alex: Great — final notes: fallback model endpoint is pinned to v3 if cluster scaleup fails. Runbook step 4 has rollback commands. I'm leaving my session open for 15m if anyone needs help.

maria: Thanks — taking the handoff at 17:00. Will DM if anything.

jamal: :raised_hands: Good handoff. Logged checked boxes in the handoff doc: https://docs.google.com/handsoff
